question: Who among the following became the first ever Indian female wrestler to win an Olympic medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sakshi Malik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sakshi Malik** **became **the** first Indian women** **wrestler **to win an **Olympic medal**.

 
 
• She won a **bronze medal **at the **2016 Rio Olympics**.
 
• She was the **fourth Indian woman** to have **won **an **Olympic medal **in **any field**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **first Indian woman** to win an **Olympic medal **was **Karnam Malleshwari**.

 
 
• She won a **bronze medal** in **weightlifting **at the 2**000 Sydney Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **P.V. Sindhu **became the **first Indian woman **to win an **Olympic silver medal.**
 
 
• She won** **at the **2016 Rio Olympics** in **Badminton**.
 
• She became the **youngest Indian woman** to win an **Olympic medal**.
